name: athair lus
text: athair lus is an Irish plant name that translates as father herb. The term denotes ground ivy. Irish tradition credited the plant with powers that work against the fairies.

attributes.attribute: the Irish designation for ground ivy, meaning father herb
believed to hold powers against the fairies

okr.objective: Identify athair lus as the Irish name for ground ivy with anti-fairy repute.
